name: hurt-back
prompt: Production animation sheet of the exact USER-APPROVED mean vicious giant rat in the supplied reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT a layout to copy. Lean wiry quadruped, narrow angular muzzle, small narrowed predatory dark eyes, small rounded ragged ears, sharp natural rat incisors, coarse bristling brown-gray fur, muted pink-brown paws/ears and long bare segmented tail. Four paws only. Detailed shaded textured hand-painted retro dungeon game art; muted earthy palette, crisp edges, warm neutral light. Keep rat mean and nasty, never cute, fluffy, plump or baby-faced. BACK view facing directly away from viewer. Face, eyes and incisors must NOT be visible. Rear haunches and tail origin at rump visible; do not turn head toward camera. TWO full-body frames LEFT then RIGHT in a single horizontal row, two equal-sized cells, landscape sheet. HURT recoil. Frame 1: rat visibly flinches, shoulders recoiling, ears flattened, claws braced, head drawn slightly back. Frame 2: tense recovering crouch, head lowered, fur still bristling. Different readable silhouettes. No blood or wounds, no glow. Same anatomy and standing scale. Each complete rat INCLUDING ENTIRE TAIL must fit inside its OWN cell with at least 12% transparent margin on every edge and a fully transparent gutter between cells; never overlap or touch. Keep body/paw registration stable. OPAQUE RAT ON GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND: every background pixel must have alpha 0. Absolutely NO colored brown haze, glow, vignette, gradient backdrop, floor or cast shadow. No text, labels, borders, grid lines or reference turnaround layout. Preserve source detail and complete whiskers, ears, paws and tails.
